## Setup

| | |
|---|---|
| **Player** (exact model + firmware if known) | e.g. CDJ-3000, fw 2.10 |
| **USB stick** (size + filesystem) | e.g. SanDisk 32 GB, FAT32 |
| **Export path** | Path A (Mixxx app v0.1.0-alpha) / Path B (CLI, commit `abc1234`) |
| **Your OS** | e.g. macOS 15.3, Apple Silicon |
| **Tracks exported** | e.g. 20, mixed FLAC + MP3 |

## How far did it get?

Step number from the [Step 3 checklist](https://github.com/sparkly-quasar/openboxxx/blob/main/docs/beta-testing.md#step-3--the-actual-test):

- [ ] 1 — player reads the stick
- [ ] 2 — tracks browsable
- [ ] 3 — playlists correct
- [ ] 4 — track loads and plays
- [ ] 5 — beatgrid correct
- [ ] 6 — hot cues correct
- [ ] 7 — memory cues correct
- [ ] 8 — colour / rating survived
- [ ] 9 — survives ~10 minutes of normal use
